thread:
toni: Quick update  launching SwiftLite (GA) for ultra-low-latency text and chat today. Targets: mobile push, realtime assistants, and webhook-driven bots. Streaming and function/tool-calling are enabled by default. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/swiftlite-ga :tada:

liam: Awesome. Any ABI/SDK changes?

toni: Minimal. SDK v2.0.0 adds helper wrappers for stream handling and a new `use_low_latency=true` client option. No key rotation required. Example Node snippet in the docs.

nora: Infra plan? rollout windows?

toni: Rolling now: 5% -> 25% in 2h -> 75% in 12h -> 100% in 36h if no perf issues. We'll activate the latency micro-path on compatible GPUs. Monitor dashboards under Console > Models > SwiftLite.

deploy-bot: [deploy] swiftlite-ga rollout batch-1 started (5% traffic) at 2026-04-01T15:20:34Z

liam: Do we need to change endpoints?

toni: There is a new endpoint: `/v1/swift.generate`. Legacy `/v1/generate` will still work but won't hit the low-latency runtime unless you pass header `X-RW-Mode: swift` or set `model: "swiftlite-*"` in the request.

nora: Tooling note: function calling schema unchanged, but we added `tool_scope` to the tool manifest so customers can restrict network access on SwiftLite. See the tools section in the migration guide.

liam: Cost implications?

toni: Slight premium per token for guaranteed tail latency. We added a cost comparator in Console so teams can estimate monthly delta based on usage.

status-bot: [monitor] swiftlite latency SLI initial: p95=45ms, p99=120ms (measured on rollout infra)
